description: Cosmological-side anchor table. Each entry pairs an observable from the einstein_sector_mapping.json with its canonical anchor (Planck 2018 / PDG / NuFIT 6.1 / SH0ES) and the loop-class prediction. The 'predicted' field is the closed-form value that the bundled loop-class library returns when fed the five measured causal-wave coefficients (alpha_xi=0.90082, D_Omega=0.83996, beta_pi=0.93791, gamma=0.10021, eps_sync2=0.05000) and the appropriate tree-input for that observable. The 'residual_pct' is the relative deviation prediction-vs-anchor; the 'tier' field reports whether it lands EXACT (<=1%), PRECISE (<=2.5%), or one of the structural classes. Bundled here so that the bridge note's cross-sector consistency claim is reproducible from this package alone, without round-tripping through the loop-class library paper.

binding_closure.name: alpha_s(M_Z) round-trip via 4-loop MS-bar running
binding_closure.framing: The binding closure is the alpha_s round-trip (EXACT). The direct Lambda comparison is sensitive to the lattice-vs-perturbative scheme spread of several percent in the literature; the corpus's prediction 0.2181 GeV sits inside that literature spread.

anchors.note: The literature spread of Lambda^(5)_MS-bar determinations is ~3% across lattice and perturbative methods (FLAG/PDG bracket 0.20-0.22 GeV). The model's prediction 0.2181 lies inside that bracket. The binding cross-check is the alpha_s(M_Z) round-trip closure which is EXACT 0.7% against the PDG anchor independently of the Lambda scheme choice.

anchors.note: Transport-formula closure eta_B = (28/51) J_CP S_bounce N_gen / g_* via the Vortex-CP-boost mechanism (Phase II baryogenesis in the wider corpus, Dossier section 7.4) yields 3.26e-10 in the canonical regime, factor 1.9 below the observed value.
